record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: Improve the known lower bounds relating H(n), the maximum number of limit cycles of degree-n planar polynomial systems, and L(n), the maximum number of crossing limit cycles of planar piecewise linear systems with two zones separated by a branch of an algebraic curve of degree n.

evidence.quote: Problem 18. Improve, if possible, the lower bounds of this table: Polynomial case Linear piecewise case H(2)≥4 L(1)≥3 H(3)≥13 L(2)≥4 H(n)≥Kn2 log(n) L(n)≥[n/2]

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For each integer n ≥ 1, define:

• H(n) = the maximum number of limit cycles that a planar polynomial differential system
   dx/dt = P(x,y),  dy/dt = Q(x,y),
with P, Q real polynomials of degree at most n, can have (a limit cycle is an isolated periodic orbit in the set of all periodic orbits).

• L(n) = the maximum number of crossing limit cycles that a planar piecewise linear differential system with two zones can have, where the two zones are the connected components of ℝ² \ Γ and Γ is a branch of a real algebraic curve of degree n; the vector field is linear (affine) on each zone, and a crossing limit cycle is an isolated periodic orbit that crosses Γ transversally at finitely many points (no sliding).

The currently known lower bounds include:
   H(2) ≥ 4,   H(3) ≥ 13,   H(n) ≥ K n² log n   (for some constant K > 0 and all n large),
   L(1) ≥ 3,   L(2) ≥ 4,    L(n) ≥ ⌊n/2⌋.

Problem. Improve any of these lower bounds, i.e. exhibit explicit families of polynomial (respectively piecewise linear) systems realizing strictly more limit cycles than the bounds above for some n, or establish improved asymptotic lower bounds for H(n) or L(n) as n → ∞.
artifact.status_search_result: The bounds in question are part of Hilbert's 16th problem, which is famously open. Recent works (e.g., on piecewise linear systems with algebraic discontinuity sets) explicitly state L(n) ≥ ⌊n/2⌋ and present this as a non-optimal bound, with improvement remaining an open problem. No source claims to have improved the asymptotic bound H(n) ≥ K n² log n or surpassed H(2) ≥ 4, H(3) ≥ 13 in general; recent progress is incremental and the overall problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: On the Hilbert number for piecewise linear vector fields with algebraic discontinuity set
status_evidence.snippet: There exists a polynomial f_n(x) of degree n and a piecewise linear differential system with two zones separated by y = f_n(x) having at least ⌊n/2⌋ hyperbolic limit cycles; consequently L(n) ≥ ⌊n/2⌋. The result does not aim to give the optimal lower bound.
status_evidence.claim: The lower bound L(n) ≥ ⌊n/2⌋ is established but improving it remains open.

status_evidence.title: The 16th Hilbert Problem for Discontinuous Piecewise Linear Differential Systems Separated by the Algebraic Curve y=x^n
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the extended Hilbert 16th problem for piecewise linear systems separated by algebraic curves of degree n.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on improving bounds related to L(n) is ongoing, indicating the problem is not closed.
